description: Authoritative sensor availability and stream integrity status enum as defined by Architecture Revision 3 and Development Design Baseline Component C-03.

definitions.AVAILABLE: All mandatory and auxiliary sensor streams are actively delivering valid, in-rate samples.
definitions.PARTIAL: Mandatory inertial sensors (accel/gyro) are healthy but auxiliary sensors (e.g. magnetometer, barometer) are missing or degraded.
definitions.GAP: Temporary sample delivery interruption, dropped batches, or non-monotonic delivery detected across sensor streams.
definitions.MISSING_MANDATORY: Mandatory inertial sensors (accelerometer or gyroscope) are unavailable, preventing valid navigation propagation.
definitions.FAILED: Irrecoverable hardware fault, permission revocation, or unrecoverable sensor callback failure.
